nodes.description: Core mapping(bytes32 => TokenData) holding level, stakeType, owner, faction and elite flags for every token.
VRF randomness seed stored after fulfillRandomness; used as entropy source in all in-contract randomness.
Mapping of addresses allowed to call the authorised modifier functions (token contract etc.).
Mapping of string keys (gen0, gen1, token, treeHouse, tokenGenerator) to external contract addresses.
Array of level milestones used to derive boosts and risk reductions.
Mapping from milestone level to ImpactType (boost, riskReduction).
Mapping from stake type to ImpactType; boost controls level yield period, riskReduction used in risk math.
EnumerableSet of elite token keys belonging to the red faction.
EnumerableSet of elite token keys belonging to the blue faction.
Cost in BLD to upgrade a tree house; multiplied by the caller-supplied upgrade amount.
Immutable LinkTokenInterface used to pay the VRF fee via transferAndCall.
authorised function that seeds initial token data (faction, elite flag, level) for a batch of token ids.
authorised function that records staking owner, stake type and enrolment timestamp and adds elites to faction sets.
authorised function that unstakes tokens, removes elites from sets and claims accrued level.
Pure helper that computes the keccak256 key for (collection, tokenId).
Public function that lets a token owner claim accrued levels; requires tokenData.owner == msg.sender.
Internal level accrual logic using block.timestamp and stakeTypeImpacts boost; writes back the new level.
Computes risk, uses weak randomness to decide win/lose, and pays stolen BLD to a winning elite via external call.
Weakness-prone outcome decision hashing seed, tokenId, amount, tx.origin, blockhash and block.timestamp.
Selects the elite set (red/blue) based on faction and returns a winner address.
Picks a random index in an elite set using _getRandom and returns the owner of the selected token.
Weak PRNG hashing seed, tokenId, tx.origin, blockhash and block.timestamp modulo a length.
Weak pseudo-random faction derivation from seed, tokenId, tx.origin, blockhash and block.timestamp.
Pays BLD through an external token call and increases the house level of a caller-owned tree house token.
authorised function that increases the stored level of a token by an arbitrary amount.
authorised function marking a token as elite if not already elite and unstaked.
onlyOwner function that requests VRF randomness by paying vrfFee in LINK.
VRF callback override that stores the returned randomness into the seed state variable.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and authorised modifier gating.
Miner-influenceable timestamp feeding level accrual and randomness calculations.
Origin address mixed into the outcome and randomness hashes, enabling tx.origin dependency.
External call IToken(contractsAddressesMap['token']).add(winner, amount_) executed before function return.
External call IToken(contractsAddressesMap['token']).spend(msg.sender, cost) interacting with an external token contract.
External call LINK.transferAndCall / requestRandomness that triggers the VRF coordinator callback path.
Level arithmetic (level += levelYield / level += upgrade_ / level += levelIncrease_) bounded only by later caps.
Predictable randomness construction from seed, tx.origin, blockhash(block.number-1) and block.timestamp.
Collection address parameter used to derive the token key.
Array of token ids used by batch staking/unstaking functions.
Single token id used in randomness and risk calculations.
Claimed BLD amount parameter fed into the lose-decision hash and payout.
Stake type parameter indexing stakeTypeImpacts for risk reduction.
House upgrade amount parameter multiplying houseUpgradeCost.
Arbitrary level increase amount supplied to addLevel/setLevel.
Owner-supplied risk value set for token generator and tree house risk.
Computed level yield derived from elapsed time and stake boost.
Computed risk value used in the lose decision.
keccak256 key for a token computed via getTokenKey.
Address of the elite that wins the stolen BLD amount.
Boolean outcome of the claim lose decision.

edges.reason: claimLevel requires tokenDataEncoded[tokenKey].owner == msg.sender, gating level claiming on caller identity.
upgradeHouseSize requires the tree house owner to equal msg.sender before spending BLD.
authorised modifier checks authorisedAddresses[msg.sender] before staking data can be written.
authorised modifier gates setTokensData on the caller address being whitelisted.
authorisedAddresses mapping is read by the authorised modifier protecting staking writes.
_claimLevelForToken accrues level from block.timestamp minus levelEnrolDate, making accrual timestamp dependent.
_didLoseClaimAmount mixes block.timestamp into the outcome hash, allowing miner timestamp influence.
_getRandom includes block.timestamp in the entropy source of the winner selection.
_getFaction derives faction from block.timestamp among other predictable values.
_didLoseClaimAmount hashes tx.origin, making the outcome dependent on the transaction origin.
_getRandom hashes tx.origin into the pseudo-random index computation.
_getFaction hashes tx.origin into the faction derivation.
The stored VRF seed is consumed by _didLoseClaimAmount as the primary entropy input.
The seed state variable is hashed inside _getRandom for winner index selection.
The seed state variable is hashed inside _getFaction.
fulfillRandomness writes the returned randomness into the seed state variable.
isClaimSuccessful performs an external token add() call before returning, allowing reentrant control flow.
isClaimSuccessful delegates the lose decision to _didLoseClaimAmount(risk, tokenId, amount).
isClaimSuccessful calls pickWinnerFromElites when the claim is lost.
pickWinnerFromElites dispatches to _pickWinnerFromElitesBySide with the selected elite set.
_pickWinnerFromElitesBySide uses _getRandom to choose an elite index.
isClaimSuccessful calls _getFaction for non-bear collections to choose the winning side.
claimLevel invokes _claimLevelForToken for each selected token.
unsetStakedTokenData calls _claimLevelForToken before clearing the stake type.
_claimLevelForToken adds levelYield to the stored level, an arithmetic update on token state.
addLevel performs level += levelIncrease_ with a caller-controlled increase.
upgradeHouseSize adds the upgrade amount to the house level after the cap require.
upgradeHouseSize calls the external token spend() before/around state mutation, exposing an external call surface.
initSeedGeneration triggers the LINK.transferAndCall/requestRandomness external call path.
The randomness request path results in the VRF coordinator invoking fulfillRandomness as a callback.
isClaimSuccessful outcome relies on the weak randomness construction.
_didLoseClaimAmount implements the weak hash using blockhash and block.timestamp.
_getRandom implements the weak randomness construction used for winner selection.
_getFaction implements the weak randomness construction for faction choice.
setTokensData computes token keys through getTokenKey.
setStakedTokenData computes token keys through getTokenKey.
unsetStakedTokenData computes token keys through getTokenKey.
_claimLevelForToken derives the storage key via getTokenKey.
isClaimSuccessful repeatedly derives token keys via getTokenKey.
levelMilestones drives the boost/riskReduction lookup inside isClaimSuccessful.
levelImpacts supplies the risk reduction subtracted from risk in isClaimSuccessful.
stakeTypeImpacts boost is the divisor in the level yield computation.
pickWinnerFromElites reads the redElites set for non-faction winners.
pickWinnerFromElites reads the blueElites set for faction winners.
setStakedTokenData inserts elite tokens into redElites.
setStakedTokenData inserts elite tokens into blueElites.
_claimLevelForToken reads and writes token level/levelEnrolDate in tokenDataEncoded.
isClaimSuccessful reads level, faction and owner from tokenDataEncoded for risk and winner logic.

normalization_plan.reason: collection_ parameters only feed the getTokenKey helper that derives storage keys.
tokenIds_ batches are iterated exclusively to write staking data for each token.
tokenId_ is mixed into the outcome/randomness hash of the lose decision.
amount_ is hashed into the lose decision and used as the payout value.
stakeType_ indexes stakeTypeImpacts for risk reduction inside the claim check.
upgrade_ scales houseUpgradeCost and the house level increase.
levelIncrease_ is added directly to the stored token level.
risk_ values configure the risk constants consumed by the claim check.
levelYield is the delta applied by the level arithmetic update.
local risk accumulates the computed probability used by the claim check.
tokenKey is the keccak256 output of the getTokenKey helper.
winner is the address passed into the external token add() payout call.
didLose is the boolean outcome controlling the payout branch of the claim check.
